visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins in a minimalist white void where a blue six-legged cat (Bugcat Capoo) and a yellow cat with a pineapple top (Pineapple Capoo) walk toward each other, each carrying a tray with a burger, fries, and a soda. (2) The two characters jump and collide in mid-air; Bugcat Capoo instantly expands its mouth to a massive size, swallowing both trays of food whole while Pineapple Capoo looks on in shock. (3) They land on the ground; Bugcat Capoo finds a small dollop of green wasabi on a tray, eats it, and walks off while Pineapple Capoo stares intensely at a remaining bit of wasabi. (4) Pineapple Capoo's face turns red and then yellow as a massive beam of green energy shoots vertically out of its head, representing the spicy wasabi burn. (5) Bugcat Capoo walks back across the frame and is accidentally swallowed by the green energy beam, causing its face to turn pale blue and green wasabi drool to leak from its mouth. (6) A small white bunny appears behind Pineapple Capoo; the background shifts to a dark grey gradient with long shadows. (7) The bunny suddenly transforms into a giant, horrific ghost with black weeping eyes and a screaming mouth, causing Pineapple Capoo to scream in terror.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 0 real humans. 3 animated characters: Bugcat Capoo, Pineapple Capoo, and Bunny.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An animated blue six-legged cat-creature and a yellow cat-creature with a pineapple crown and sunglasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Starts with a pure white minimalist background and transitions to a dark grey gradient with dramatic shadows at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Playful, high-tempo electronic BGM starts immediately. A sharp 'clack' impact sound marks the collision, followed by a rapid-fire cartoonish munching sound effect as food is consumed. (2) A high-pitched 'ding' synth effect triggers when the wasabi is discovered on the tray. (3) A loud, roaring synthesized energy beam sound (a mix of white noise and high-frequency oscillation) erupts to accompany the green beam. (4) A wet, squelching 'blub' sound plays as the blue cat drools green liquid. (5) The upbeat music stops abruptly, replaced by a low-frequency, ominous ambient drone as the bunny appears. (6) A sudden, piercing, high-arousal non-human scream ends the video with a final percussive thud.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Conflict (Greed/Wasabi) -> Escalation -> Twist Horror Ending
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers with a surreal, cute-to-creepy animated comedy short involving popular characters Capoo and Pineapple Capoo.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a classic bait-and-switch comedy tactic where the cute aesthetic is suddenly replaced by a high-contrast horror visual at the very end.
